# anecdotes_control (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing Anecdotes control by its control ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_control" "access_reviews" {
  control_id   = "control_12345"
  framework_id = "framework_12345"
}

output "control_name" {
  value = data.anecdotes_control.access_reviews.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The unique identifier of the control to look up.
- `framework_id` (String) The framework ID that the control belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) The category name this control belongs to.
- `category_id` (String) The framework category ID this control belongs to.
- `description` (String) A detailed description of the control.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the control.
- `owners` (List of String) List of email addresses of users who own this control.
- `status` (String) The current status of the control.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the control.
